title: Explore Australian State and Territory Population Growth
text: PopulationExplorer R package developed ETC5523: Communicating Data Monash University. provides interactive Shiny application exploring Australian state territory population changes 2010 2025. application intended students members public interested Australian population trends. Research question: Australian state territory populations changed 2010 2025, areas experienced faster growth?

title: Explore Australian State and Territory Population Growth
text: Shiny application allows users : Select Australian state territory. Choose starting ending year. Explore annual population trends using interactive selection line chart. Calculate absolute percentage population growth. View table annual population estimates. Read automatically generated interpretations population changes. application also provides explanatory information, data limitations helpful messages invalid year selections.

title: Explore Australian State and Territory Population Growth
text: package includes population_tidy, dataset containing 128 observations Australia’s eight states territories. dataset contains three variables: year: Calendar year, 2010–2025. state: State territory abbreviation. population: Estimated resident population persons. original data obtained Australian Bureau Statistics (ABS), National, state territory population, Table 4: Estimated Resident Population, States Territories. Source: https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/people/population/national-state--territory-population data prepared selecting June population estimates 2010–2025, retaining eight states territories converting spreadsheet tidy format. preparation script original spreadsheet included data-raw directory reproducibility.
